planets.name: HD 118203 c
planets.description: Planet of HD 118203 found by radial velocity, with a 5100-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: HD 118203 c was found in 2024 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 118203. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Zhang et al. 2024's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
